specs.derived_from: Owner earnings, incremental returns, or reinvestment runway fall below the low-case bridge.
specs.rationale: Types the owner-earnings leg of the prose falsifier. The low-case bridge grows normalized owner earnings from the low-case trace anchor (owner_earnings, kind=fact); a resolved value below that anchor means the trajectory has fallen below the low-case bridge. The incremental-returns and reinvestment-runway legs are judgments with no resolvable metric and are not typed. Threshold is the low-case proof-trace value verbatim; resolved from the fact ledger's locked normalized_owner_earnings_m row. Due is the next expected filing (Q2 FY2026 10-Q, ~2026-08-28) plus 60 days.
